facts.text: The resort spreads across 800 acres of palms and water.
facts.excerpt: Spread across 800 sprawling acres of lush palms and sparkling water

facts.text: The resort has two championship golf courses.
facts.excerpt: Tee off on two championship golf courses or play family-friendly mini golf.

facts.text: Alongside 36 holes of golf, the resort has an 18-hole miniature golf course.
facts.excerpt: In addition to 36 holes of world-class golf, our resort also features 18-holes of miniature golf, offering options for golfers of all levels.

facts.text: The resort has a wave pool, an on-site water park and a lazy river.
facts.excerpt: splash across the wave pool, experience our on-site water park and relax in the lazy river

facts.text: There are multiple pools, one of them reserved for adults.
facts.excerpt: Multiple pools (including an adults-only pool), a water park and a lazy river

facts.text: Eagles Edge at ChampionsGate uses Toptracer technology, with hitting bays for competing, virtual games and instant feedback.
facts.excerpt: Powered by Toptracer technology, Eagles Edge at ChampionsGate offers a unique destination to compete, play virtual games, and enjoy instant feedback

facts.text: The full-service spa offers facial and body treatments and salon services.
facts.excerpt: Relax and revive at our full-service spa offering facial and body treatments and salon services.

facts.text: The resort has tennis and pickleball courts.
facts.excerpt: Tennis and pickleball courts

facts.text: The resort has an on-site sports field complex.
facts.excerpt: An on-site sports field complex

facts.text: The fitness center is fully equipped and has Peloton bikes.
facts.excerpt: A fully-equipped fitness center with Peloton bikes

facts.text: Two-bedroom villas sleep up to six and three-bedroom villas up to ten, each with a fully equipped kitchen, living area, private terrace or balcony and golf views.
facts.excerpt: offering spacious two-bedroom villas for up to six guests and luxurious three-bedroom villas for up to ten, each featuring fully equipped kitchens, living areas, private terraces or balconies, and stunning golf views

facts.text: Suites have a king bed, a living area with a sleeper sofa, a marble bath with separate shower, and a private balcony with golf and pool views.
facts.excerpt: featuring a plush king bed, spacious living area with a sleeper sofa, and a lavish marble bath with separate shower and vanity. Enjoy golf and pool views from your private balcony

facts.text: Premier Rooms look out over the golf courses and recreation areas.
facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in breathtaking views of lush golf courses, scenic recreation areas, and expansive natural beauty from our Premier Rooms.

facts.text: Sunset Lodge rooms have a bathroom with a walk-in shower and offer access to wellness programs.
facts.excerpt: Sunset Lodge rooms blend contemporary style, luxury bedding, and a spacious bathroom with a walk-in shower, while also offering access to wellness programs that support your fitness goals.

facts.text: The resort is 12 miles from Disney World and 21 miles from Universal Studios Florida.
facts.excerpt: Omni Orlando Resort at ChampionsGate is located 12 miles from Disney World and 21 miles from Universal Studios Florida.

facts.text: Orlando International Airport is about 26 miles away, roughly 53 minutes.
facts.excerpt: About 26 miles (approximately 53 minutes) from Orlando International Airport (MCO)

facts.text: The resort charge includes scheduled transport to the Walt Disney World theme parks.
facts.excerpt: Scheduled transport service Walt Disney World® theme parks

facts.text: Parking, self or valet, carries a nightly charge.
facts.excerpt: Self and valet parking with a nightly charge

facts.text: The resort is pet friendly for animals under 50 pounds, with a one-time pet fee.
facts.excerpt: Yes, Omni Orlando Resort at ChampionsGate is a pet friendly hotel for animals under 50 pounds. There is a one-time non-refundable pet fee

facts.text: Dining includes four full-service restaurants, a sushi and sake bar, a deli, a lobby bar, a pool bar and dining at Eagles Edge.
facts.excerpt: Nine dining outlets - four full-service restaurants, a sushi and sake bar, a deli, a lobby bar, a pool bar and dining at Eagles Edge

facts.text: Restaurants serve cuisines from Chinese to Italian to American.
facts.excerpt: offering a variety of cuisines from Chinese to Italian to American

facts.text: The resort is Four Diamond-rated.
facts.excerpt: the Four Diamond-rated Omni Orlando Resort at ChampionsGate is a haven of rest and relaxation

facts.text: The resort has 255,000 square feet of meeting and event space.
facts.excerpt: 255,000 square feet of meeting and event space

facts.text: A complimentary shuttle runs from the Villas and Sunset Lodge to the main resort, pools and golf on request.
facts.excerpt: you may request a complimentary shuttle to any resort location (main resort, pools and golf)

contradictions.note: Overview paragraph says 10 premium restaurants; FAQ lists nine dining outlets

sources.excerpt: Choose from 10 premium restaurants offering a variety of cuisines from Chinese to Italian to American
Nine dining outlets - four full-service restaurants, a sushi and sake bar, a deli, a lobby bar, a pool bar and dining at Eagles Edge
